fossabotDesc: Type your channel name and your public Fossabot commands page is read for you. No sign-in, no token.
instrFossabot: Open your Fossabot commands page: fossabot.com/yourchannel/commands. It is public, so there is nothing to sign in to.
Your channel name is the part of that address before /commands, normally your Twitch login.
Type that channel name below to continue.
Only what that page lists comes over. Commands hidden from the directory, timers, keywords and cooldowns are not published there, so they stay behind.
instrHint: Follow these steps in {source}, then provide what is asked below. Your file is read right here in the browser. Nothing is uploaded until you preview.
instrMoobot: Sign in at moobot.ai and open your dashboard.
Click “Export this dashboard to a file” and save the .json file.
Choose that file below to continue.
instrNightbot: Click “Connect Nightbot” below. You'll be sent to nightbot.tv to sign in and approve access.
Approve the request (commands, timers and spam protection, read for this import only) and you'll land right back here.
Hit Continue and pick what to import.
instrSe: Sign in at streamelements.com and open your dashboard.
Go to Account Settings → Channels, or use the direct link below.
Copy your JWT token from your StreamElements account.
Paste the JWT below to continue.
instrSl: On the computer where the StreamLabs Chatbot desktop app runs, close the app first so the database is fully written.
Locate Chatbot.db and upload it below to continue.
instrWizebot: In your Wizebot panel, open the Streaming Website section and turn it on if it is off. Your command list is only published while that site is enabled.
Your channel login is the subdomain of that site: in yourchannel.streaming.lv, it is yourchannel.
Type that login below to continue.

Only commands that post chat text come over. Screen animations and sound-only commands are skipped, and when a command carries a public description, Wizebot publishes that instead of its chat message, so check the review step.
jwtHint: Copy your JWT token from your StreamElements account, then paste it here.
